DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_BELL_1: There's that unidentified signal again! I looked through my signalscope- why does it sound so familiar..?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_BELL_2: The unidentified signal in the lobby can only be realised by focusing your signalscope on it.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_KNIGHT_1: Future me probably won't mind a little challenge, even if it is coming from that little guy.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_KNIGHT_2: In the past, this barrier didn't exist. Purple requested it as a challenge for the present.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_POOLENTR_1: The door is locked again... Last time it was unlocked, I saw Blue messing around with the wallpaper nearby, but I'm not quite sure why.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_POOLENTR_2: When a door is locked, look for drawings nearby.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_POOLEND_1: These crystals remind me of ghost matter, but I don't get hurt when I touch them. The last thing for me to try in my testing process is my Little Scout. I wonder if- [The text abruptly ends.]
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_POOLEND_2: Blue crystals are byproducts of a temporal invisible temporal disturbance. Sudden kinetic energy when applied to the crystal makes the disturbance visible.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_FURNACE_1: Wow, the Furnace survived yet another experiment. I don't think that Blue and I will manage to find a way to break it. Blue suggested that the room itself might be affecting the efficiency of the Furnace, so we're going to test that theory. I hope what Green said about the Furnace isn't true.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_FURNACE_2: The Furnace never stops operating. It will always heat up the floor selected with its dial, provided the target is accessible.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_WATERLEAK_1: Recently, water has been dripping from the ceiling. I will have to talk to Blue about responsible usage of cryonic tools.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_WATERLEAK_2: The room above 272 always has issues that require investigating.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_BASEMENT_1: Finally got the improvised Ash Twin Project working. Blue would have loved to see this thing kicking off. The only problem is that neither me or Blue or anyone else is able to kickstart this thing. Maybe if I try stirring some trouble? Can’t risk involving Blue or the others anymore.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_BASEMENT_2: The Ash Twin Project will only start working when a crisis is happening.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_ECHRIPSIGNAL_1: What is this? Another signal? Huh that's weird. This one can be lined up with one of those apperitions I have talked to.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Stickynotes_ECHRIPSIGNAL_2: Lining up an Echo or Ripple with their origin(a person) affects the origin at a distance.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_INIT01_1: Welcome back, Newcomer. Have you forgotten everything again?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_INIT02_1: Hey, it's going to be alright, Newcomer. Let me explain where you are and what is going on again, I know memory loss is becoming increasingly common for you, but I'm not going anywhere, as much as you might want me to.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_INIT02_2: You're in Hotel Penumbra, the only establishment with capacity for every living being in your universe. There are three floors you have access to, at the moment.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_INIT02_3: This hotel is much larger than you could ever comprehend. It accommodates itself to your own cognitive capacity, which is... somewhat unimpressive, in the case of your species.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_INIT02_4: On top of all of that, reality is relative, here. Your thoughts and feelings can morph this place, to your betterment, or your detriment.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_INIT01_B: No... but I would like a refresher on some of the basic things.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_INIT03_1: Certainly. Not like it's the first time you've asked.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_MAIN01_1: A basic grasp of Hotel Penumbra can mean life or death for you, after all. It's better to know what something is before you mess with it and get shattered across spacetime, hah!
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_MAIN01_QUESTIONS: I have some questions about this place.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_MAIN02_1: In an objective situation, that would be impossible. However, it seems that you already left, or you are leaving, or you will leave, one way or another. However, to make a patron's wish real in Hotel Penumbra, all luggage must be held by the patron before their departure. It's just a company policy we had to implement after the upcoming incident. Were you carrying anything when you entered?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_MAIN01_B: I'm rather lost. How do I know where to find things?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_MAIN03_1: Please pay closer attention to the room numbers- with four eyes, I'd think you'd be a little more observant!
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_END: Goodbye, and I hope you continue to enjoy your stay.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS01_1: Hmm? You're always free to ask me things, go right ahead.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS02_1: You're in Hotel Penumbra, the most exquisite establishment this side of the Big Bang. We do hope you enjoy your stay, as always.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS01_B: Why do some of the hallways turn me around?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS03_1: Turn you around? I'm not entirely sure what you mean. Our patrons have never reported any issues with translating themselves from one hall to another.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS01_C: Why are some objects acting so strangely?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS04_1: Strangely? Newcomer, you have always had so many questions to ask, but you were never willing to hear the answers to any of them. Open your mind a bit to what is truly 'strange', why don't you?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS01_D: Why is that one part of the wall you're staring at different?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS05_1: Whether a wall is a wall is a matter of perspective. I faintly recall a boisterous little fellow huffing and puffing about some door. I couldn't quite read his behaviour. A reflection of my past. I apologize, but you have instructed me to not help you out like I did last time, so I am to remain ambiguous. I hope that you can forgive me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS01_E: What is that door behind you for?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS06_1: The basement door is locked for your safety. You should know this by now.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS01_END: I think that's all I had to ask.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_QUESTIONS01_FLOORS: Could you tell me about the different floors of the hotel?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FLOORS01_1: Oh, certainly, but I'm going to need a little more specificity than that.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FLOORS01_A: What can you tell me about the first floor?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FLOORS02_1: The first floor is the most popular of them all, and it's almost always full. However, as far as I know, a creature of considerable violence and impudence resides there at the moment. Tread lightly, else it may be a bumpy ride for you.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FLOORS01_B: What can you tell me about the second floor?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FLOORS03_1: The second floor is home to a true tragedy... or at least, that's what you told me before you seemingly forgot it all again. To avoid the endless sorrow, follow the signs on floor two.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FLOORS01_C: What can you tell me about the third floor?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FLOORS04_1: The third floor is supposed to be largely unoccupied. It's scheduled for reconstruction. Because it's vacant, I am confident that there shouldn't be any locked doors to impede your poking around.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND01_1: Oh? And what might you have found?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND01_A: I found what I think were ghosts.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND02_1: Ah, I see you've rediscovered them yet again. I do hope they're still keeping their rooms tidy.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND01_B: I found bubbles that send the surrounding matter back in time.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND03_1: Oh, the time bubbles! Please do not interfere with any maintenance you may witness in the past- we wish to keep the hotel tidy.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND01_C: I found a... void, or at least, that's what it looks like to me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND04_1: Unfortunately, I know of it as well. I do not wish to discuss this further.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND01_D: I found a cobbled-together machine that looks like the Ash Twin Project from my solar system.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Bellhop_FOUND05_1: Ah, the time-traveling communication device, yes? Do be careful with it, I don't want any burn-marks on the carpet, please.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_ECHO_1: Splash! Mama lost again. Now the experiment can continue... No? Why would I release toxic fumes? Ooooh! The big scary black rock in the sky? No this experiment is endothermic. I asked teacher and the black rain shouldn't go boom. Shouldn't? Yes mama, but science! Risk is necessary! I love you too mom. Endothermic reaction success! Mama happy! I get good grade in school. Why the black rock moving mama? Possible?
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_RIPPLE_1: The black rock destroyed. Possible? I will make possible. Others must be safe again. No quantum entanglement anymore. Destroy uncertainty principle. When leave hotel. Newcomer must not stop me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_ONE_1a: Curiosity. Seek out. Similar molecules, Newcomer and me. Good.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_ONE_2b: Jump in pool! No! Jump over pool. Water nice? Air nicer? Splash bad? Molecules touch skin. If safe, then stay. Corrosive? Newcomer not corrosive. Newcomer good. Newcomer lost key. No! Newcomer find key.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_ONE_3c: Future good! Future uncertain. Uncertainty follows chaos. Chaos necessary. Otherwise heat death. Heat death boring! Remove the boring. Nothing can be boring? Ice is not boring. Yes! No. Ice gone. Please? Find ice block.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_TWO_EITHER_1a: Planet. Decay. Not end. New possibilities. Safe.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_TWO_ECHO_1b: This place uncertain. Too much uncertainty. Stability disappears. Increase the heat to prevent ice forming. Newcomer prefers water. Newcomer forgot. Newcomer must not forget. Not again! Forget erodes stability? Or forget part of stability? Why is forgetting needed?
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_TWO_ECHO_2c:
Basement bad. Choice made. Choices unmade. Choice made. Choices unmade. No choice, yes stability. Choices dangerous. Newcomer must chose. Newcomer not choose basement. Newcomer not choose? No!!! Newcomer must choose. Newcomer has chosen and must choose again...
Question?
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_TWO_RIPPLE_1B: Sticky notes useful! Maybe leave. Left behind. For science! Science opens doors. Kaboom! No? Newcomer told me. Sticky notes no. Experiment other. Why?
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_TWO_RIPPLE_2C: Newcomer likes basement. Basement yes? No! No science. Only answers. Why? Questions good?
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_THREE_1a:
New planet. Black hole close. Unsafe. Unsafe! UNSAFE! UNSAFE! UNSAFE!
You Newcomer? You are not Newcomer. Where did you come from? I come with? Why I forget? Mama? No mama with the decayed planet. I promise to start a new world.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_THREE_2b:
You remember big hot thing? That melt ice? It has dial. Newcomer loved switching the dial to basement. Can you imitate Newcomer? Second thing you must do. Newcomer didn't forsee this. The breaker short-circuited. You should go outside. Will you? You have to be right once you leave.
Hope!
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_WISP_THREE_3c:
You shall make big gathering building safe for us. Happy now! New possibilities open up for me. Much science to do with you! Touch molecules. Measure liquid streams. What's your inside body pressure? I will touch the wall of big building. It is not like your skin. Why? Not important. Say hello to Newcomer for me. We never finished previous experiment.
Measure angles!
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_ECHO_1:
Dear love undying
Winter's chill took her from me
Love shall never spring
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_RIPPLE_1:
Be my guardian
Weapon for my summer's wrath
Autumn must not come
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_ONE_2b:
Music remembers
Newcomer composers for friends
The box is in past
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_ONE_3b:
The past is not here
Seek below as above comes
Walk the lobby stairs
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_ONE_4c:
Fortunate are they
Traverse together through floor
Newcomer must lie
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_ONE_5c:
Walk in solitude
Closer to greener pastures
Go too far in time
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_ONE_6c:
Stray from beaten path
Wandering the endless void
Find what will be lost
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_TWO_ECHO_1b:
Newcomer can't stop
End is inevitable
Blind leading the blind
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_TWO_ECHO_2c:
Happiness is choice
Choice starts inevitable
There never was choice
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_TWO_RIPPLE_1B:
Newcomer won't write
End is desired for me
Stay blind forever
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_TWO_RIPPLE_2C:
Basement is not true
Newcomer avoids other floors
I hate false prophet
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_THREE_2b:
Locker is a lie
Unveil truth with opposite
Sound is opposite
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_THREE_3b:
Signal needed
Signal might seem lost to you
It resides in you
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_THREE_4b:
Turn signal to veil
Open locker with your mind
Find your lost core
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_WISP_THREE_5c:
The past unwritten
Your memories might persist
Free yourself from us
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_ECHO01_A: Well. This is a novel experience.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_ECHO02_A: I have no quarrel with you, good wall. But I must cross you.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_ECHO03_A: I command you, as Newcomer to move for me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_ECHO05_1: I ride to glory! To the mill where I have worked tirelessly to impress the dazzling miller. He crushes flour like a knight crushes a delicate flower. But the miller is never impressed. Never does he compliment me on the showmanship I present when I try crushing the flour. He strikes the back of my head like the thunder that strikes an empty cave. Oh if we could but take shelter in that empty cave together from the pouring rain. But alas the miller's only request is that I open a window. If only he would open the window to my mi- Oh crap that was a mirror.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_RIPPLE01_1:
You cannot possibly think you could ever hope to obtain my deepest darkest secrets that I guard with such fervor? I require a small favour from you and then you might delve into the depths of my mind.
You must be harmed by every room in this sacred sanctuary.
But in order to be harmed by every room you must obtain all knowledge of every room.
But for you see, in order to obtain every last sticky note you must also solve the riddle of steel.
However, in order to solve the riddle of steel, the sacred sanctuary must be aligned with yourself.
However, to align this scared sanctuary with yourself, you must also hasten to destroy the Void.
However, to destroy the Void you have to talk to me?
Wait, but to talk to me, you have to talk to me?
But you can't talk to me until you have talked to me but that then requires you to talk to me which can't happen because you have to talk to me?
Okay, wait I need a moment to clear my mind- and done. Did you do all of that?
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_RIPPLE02_1: Perfect, I will now reveal the ultimate truth.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_RIPPLE03_1: To prevent the fabric of space being torn I shall now reveal the ultimate truth.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_RIPPLE04_1: I shall be like a warrior of olden days. Never shall I stop guarding the tactile feel of their gorguous books. Those written by dazzling masters of literature. I shall not be bothered by the infinitesimal small cuts the paper of the books inflicts upon my fingers. I shall carry the scars from these stories like badges of honour. Like the medal bestowed upon a knight by the prestigious prince after a long and arduous quest. No fear floods my skull. No waves are crashing upon the desert of my mind. I remain resolved and steel my nerves against the deep ocean. The watery abyss shall not hurt the pages! I will strike down the water with my mighty sword. It was made with the purpose to defeat those who oppose the chivalry code. It has blessings of the miller upon it. If only the miller could bless me personally. Let his breeze carry me far beyond the wheels of his giant mill. I shall sail the desert and the water shall tremble before me. Quaking with anticipation, I set out. None shall oppose me for I have the mir- Oh wait I have brought a glass pane.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_ONE_1a: Accept my dearest welcome from the bottom of THE KNIGHT's illustrious heart, pristine fellow lost person. It seems Newcomer has been sent on an expedition far beyond the realms where one would normally travel. Here be dragons Newcomer. They glimmer like a dazzling array of diamonds at the dawn of a day. One that will see the heroics and bravery and determination of ones such as THE KNIGHT. And mayhap Newcomer too will face off against such insurmountable mountains that oppose one
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_ONE_2b: The forces of evil have conspired against yours truly, THE KNIGHT. They will assault the walls of THE KNIGHT's mind with all their strength but THE KNIGHT will never falter against such corrupt forces. For their will is but a pale reflection; like a white horse riding towards a lake. With the wind in THE KNIGHT's hair, a storm is coming. One that shall blow away all evil deeds. Such as nightstands, closets, tables, and other evil pieces of furniture. Towering over THE KNIGHT with their similes like metaphors.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_ONE_3c: The future is uncertain. It's the herald of death, famine, and misfortune. THE KNIGHT will never cower from such disastrous trappings. However, Newcomer must understand that heralding death -a black miasma with noble intent that sweeps justice- is not the path a true warrior of justice must take. However, should Newcomer persist then THE KNIGHT might have a small favour to ask. Seek out THE KNIGHT when the future is most dilapidated and rotten and abandoned.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_TWO_EITHER_1a: Oh, how THE KNIGHT has long awaited the long-awaited thrilling conclusion to THE KNIGHT's endless journeys along the abyss of the heart. For I have seen in the depths of my soul, Newcomer and I -the great knight of the new Dawn- will always know that nothing shall stand in my way. Except mayhap those woefully tasty "pompouses"
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_TWO_ECHO_1b: Oh woe is upon THE KNIGHT. For this darkness. This endless, unceasing threat that endangers Newcomer and THE KNIGHT shall never stop gnawing away at us. It shall be like a ceaseless discharge, opening the very mouth of hell. Abandon all hope, ye who enter here. But if Newcomer holds fast against the endless ocean washing away our powers of light then mayhap, the small favour shall be carried out.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_TWO_ECHO_2c: Oh pristine Newcomer. Oh mighty herald of the past. Let your powers flow through THE KNIGHT once more. THE KNIGHT gapes in awe at Newcomer's awesomeness. THE KNIGHT drools and weeps over what could have been. Newcomer understood the debased basement of doom. Newcomer understands that the basement is the forbidden fruit that we must resist. Unless THE KNIGHT is sundered.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_TWO_RIPPLE_1B: The ocean is smoke and mirrors. For I, THE KNIGHT have read the words of the messiah. Newcomer prophesied that salvation does not lie within the ocean of darkness. For it is a cruel mistress with a temper to rival Newcomer. And temptation must be denied in order to reach the summit of salvation.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_TWO_RIPPLE_2C: Newcomer knows the paths of this labyrinthian halls of utter gargantuan magnitude better than all. All those who deny this truth are not pure enough of heart. Like a fragile red rose, their heart withers and slithers through the endless hallways. Never shall they find their ill-coveted basement.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_THREE_1a: A joyous occasion came upon me. A righteous feast was thrown in honour of my great heroics and bravery. For I had transcended the likes of a mere miller and the wheels of progress. I was content to say only a few words. And those few words echoed through the great halls of my forefathers who had constructed them of the properly measured wooden beams. And such as I was the great hero of the mill, it pales in comparison to the dazzling brilliance of Newcomer. Wait, this is wrong. Where am I? You're not Newcomer. What have I done? I have been a victim of my own foolishness. Even when the water engulfed my lungs, I could not accept that this was the end. You broke the spell that this pandemonium inflicted upon me. Was this all but an hallucination as I took my final breaths? No. I see clearly now. I did take my final breaths but then appeared here instead of the halls of my forefathers. Wait, I don't have any forefathers chronicled. I was but a simple laborer who had learned to read. I thought imitating those heroes would make me one. I was dismounted by the giant mill and fell off the cliff into the sea. I am no hero.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_THREE_2b: What have I spouted to you? I am but a miserable pile of secrets. I apologize to you. I tried shattering the mirror but couldn't. Even when Newcomer entrusted me with this most important task. Even when they depended on me. I feared the Bellhop's mirror more than I feared Newcomer's wrath. Your questing has shown me that mayhap fear is not the unsurmountable mountain I thought it was. Mirror's Peak is where your salvation lies. You mustn't attempt to scratch the mirror. Use your weapon to capture an image instead of the mirror.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_WISP_THREE_3c: Although I have delayed your spring, I hope that you can find clemency in your heart. Forgive me for my lies to you. Newcomer was the only one who I could trust until now. We are lost in this river of time. This prison of doom. We can only prepare ourselves for what is to come. I must not blame the shadow. It merely follows our actions. Whether you succeed or not, I hope that we stay friends.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Choice01_1: Have you made your choice yet or do you want to run through everything one more time? Memories work in strange ways here.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Choice01_A: I will give you the core.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Choice02_1: Thank you. I won't disappoint you. This meeting was neccessary. Still, I hope you won't mind if we meet again in the future. I don't want to see our story end with a whimper but with a bang. Time for me to properly meet all the travellers!
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Choice01_B: I want to run by everything we have discussed one more time.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Choice03_1: Sure, what is one more loop gonna do?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_IAmYou01_1: Yeah. I mean sort of. I am you from the past.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_IAmYou01_A: Why does your voice sound so coarse?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_IAmYou02_1: It has been millions of loops since I was taken.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_IAmYou03_1: Yes. I do not know by what exactly and that Bellhop hasn't been exactly useful.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_IAmYou03_A: The Bellhop? They have been very useful to me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_IAmYou04_1: Figures that at least one of us would find a use out of them. How are they doing? Did they give you marshmallows?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_IAmYou04_A: They didn't actually give me any marshmallows.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Marshmallow_1: That's a shame. Their marshmallows are timeless.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_IAmYou04_B: I was busy traversing this strange hotel.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Busy01_1: More than fair. Seems like you have been traversing nearly the whole hotel.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Busy01_A: Nearly? Oh right, the sleepy dark hallways.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Busy02_1: Sleep isn't entirely the correct word but you're me anyways so who am I arguing with?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps01_A: Regardless of what or who took you. We must leave!
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps02_1: Only one of us though. Say, you talked to the three fading ghosts out there?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps02_A: You mean Blue, Green, and Purple?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps03_1: Prose has never been our strong suit.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps03_A: No, not particularly. Purple tries really hard even if he is a bit wordy.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps04_1: Don't get too distracted by their ideas of megalomania.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps04_A: I suppose you or rather me- Wait who is right here?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps05_1: I think arguing this for too long might tear the fabric of my mind.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps04_B: You are vain for viewing it that way. Or rather I am vain? You don't suppose we have a mirror here to check?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps06_1: I made sure to not have any mirrors here for that reason.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps0506_A: Regardless, they have been good... people. They are people, right?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps07_1: They used to be like you and me. Different species but less faded. When I arrived, they had already begun to fade but were more talkative. Green even spoke without using Haikus all the time.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps07_A: That's good to hear. What did they talk about with you?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps08_1: Nothing good. They still miss their partner.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps08_A: Oh, I was afraid that was the case. Were they able to explain to you what had happened?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps08_B: Partner? Green was married? What happened?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps09_1: Old age unfortunately. Green explained it as winter having arrived. But for themselves the seasons had stopped moving.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps09_A: I think they have found some peace now.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps10_1: I wish Green shared their autumn with us.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps11_1: But anyways, how is Blue doing?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps11_A: They are doing great as ever. Nothing gets under that on's skin, does it?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps12_1: Not really no. We even ran a few experiments to try and see if you insult them enough to fight back. For some reason they never did.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Wisps12_A: Their fortitude is rock solid. Although they do seem quite young compared to Green and Purple?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_WispEnd_1: Yeah. They must have just turned adult before coming to the hotel. I never had the courage to ask about their past. And now it's too late.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave01_A: Too late? What do you mean? I understand how to bring back their lost aspects and they even saw that I wasn't you. Or well, I mean- You know what I mean.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave02_1: I wasn't referring to us when I said that.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave03_1: I have been stuck here for over 400 years. I couldn't escape and also couldn't find peace in here. Blue, Green, and Purple. I tried to comfort them, help them.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave03_2: However, all I saw were faded echoes of what Timber Hearth... I wish to talk to Slate, Hall and the others one last time. I already failed here. Let me leave this place.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave03_A: And I take your place here? How are you going to take the advanced warp core to-
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave04_1: To the Vessel? I have already seen you do everything. I should be able to mirror your actions.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave05_1: I wouldn't fail. I would first put the advanced warp core back in the Ash Twin Project. Then I can fianlly spend some time with the people in my- I mean our village. Please I have failed so often here. You're the last hope I have for any kind of future.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave05_A: And I would be stuck in the past?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave06_1: Well, I am you. You already spend so many loops in our home. Now let me spend some loops there as well.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave06_2: I can't take care of Blue, Green, and Purple. You can though. When I abandoned them to work on my escape, I never thought they would speak again. But you might delay their fading indefinitely. Or at least longer than me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave06_A: It's a lot that you're asking of me. But you have been stuck here for even longer than I have been stuck in my loop back home. Logically speaking, I would want you to help me achieve my dream of home if our roles were reversed.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave07_1: Exactly! You're not just doing it for me. You're also doing it for yourself.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Leave07_A: I will need some time to think this through.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LeaveEnd_1: Take all the time you need. Once you have made up your mind, you can hand over the Advanced Warp Core to me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Start_B: This is the worst day of my life!
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_WorstDay02_1: As far as I have understood it. This place makes it so that tomorrow never existed. I could see your present and past actions over and over. I could never see your future no matter how much I tried.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_WorstDay02_A: Could it mean that you don't have a future?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_WorstDay03_1: Don't give me attitude. Treat yourself with respect. What have you observed in this place?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_WorstDay03_A: It seems that everything here is meant to fade away eventually. I only ever saw notes left behind by you. I imagine that there was more writing on the wall besides the Haikus and the drawing?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_WorstDay04_1: Yes. When I arrived, there were notes left behind by Purple everywhere. They were worse at writing than speaking. However, I have also seen some books from Purple and Blue homeworld reappear. Everything here endlessly folds back on itself instead of moving forward.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_WorstDay04_A: Until you pulled me in. How did you do that?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Arrival01_1: I have no clue. I had a clue but all my notes were done on the walls. Some notes were even beyond the dark hallways. But those are no longer passable.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Arrival01_A: I suppose that we have to figure that one out in the future?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Arrival02_1: Yeah. I didn't have enough time during your successful loop to commit it all to memory. And it seems that the basement is one-way in terms of memories for people. Hence the improvised Ash Twin Project. However, that did mean that I essentially had one shot before you would turn off the lights. My memory has deterioated so much that I had to focus on memorizing just the bits that would help me explain my wish to you.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Arrival02_A: Hmm. I had a suspicion that is why you chose the basement. The machine bypasses the restrictions our minds have. Then, me being here creates enough instability that I can still link up with it despite not being a machine. Very daring.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Arrival03_A: Seems a bit vain but what can you do?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Arrival04_1: Nothing but discuss the endless collasping of possiblities.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LastWord01_1: Nothing. Best not to think about that one yet. That's for the future.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LastWord01_A: Right. We're gonna focus on the past.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LastWord02_1: Let's just stick to the present.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LastWord02_A: Let me have the last word.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LastWord03_1: I am you. That's a futile argument.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LastWord03_A: Right but you're the one who pulled me in.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LastWord06_1: Finally you acknowledge my superior rhetoric. Wait but does that count as reverse psychology? How would I know for sure that-
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_LastWord06_A: Just breathe and take it easy. You can have the final word.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Screaming01_1: Oh no. You were supposed to be the chosen one. You should have been able to help me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Screaming02_1: Are you going to calm down at some point?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Screaming03_1: Okay, you're just gonna lose your mind like that?
DialogueDictionary.PH_Newcomer_Screaming04_1: Alright then. I will let you scream for a few minutes. Get it out of your system and then come talk to me.

ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PLAYER_ROOM_1: I have landed in some strange structure after trying to exit the Ash Twin Project with the Advanced Warp Core. The Core is missing.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_HOTEL_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_1: There is a sticky note on a desk in the lobby.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_HOTEL_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_2: The note mentions that the Signalscope can be used to make one's beliefs into something material. There seems to be a signal behind the desk.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_HOTEL_CURIOSITY_1: Projecting my beliefs behind the desk revealed someone who calls themself the Bellhop. They revealed to me basic information about the hotel.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_RUMOR_1: There is a spot for a door at the front of the lobby, but there's no door there.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_RUMOR_2: The Bellhop claims that he sees a door there.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_RUMOR_3: Purple mentioned that to leave the hotel, I will need to look through someone else's perspective who can see the exit.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_RUMOR_4: The Bellhop said that I need to have all my luggage to leave the hotel.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_1: I took a picture of the Bellhop's perspective of the door, which made the door appear when I entered the lobby. I can now go outside.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_2: The outside of the hotel is dark and tranquil.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_3: I found an electrical box outside the hotel.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_4: I found what seems to be an exit, but I need all of my "luggage" before I may leave.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_5: I tried to leave, but as I was passing through the exit, the loop immediately ended and I woke up back at the hotel.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_RUMOR_1: There is a locked door behind the Bellhop. He says it leads to the basement.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_RUMOR_2: I reset the breaker power connected to the basement.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_RUMOR_3: I set the furnace heat to be sent to the basement. The door is warm to the touch.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_RUMOR_4: Blue mentioned that in order to unlock the basement, the breaker outside the hotel must be reset, and heat must be sent to the basement.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_1: In the basement, I found some kind of recreation of the Ash Twin Project.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_2: I removed a makeshift Advanced Warp Core from the system.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FIRST_FLOOR_RUMOR_1: The Bellhop told me that most of the hotel's occupants are on the first floor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FIRST_FLOOR_1: The first floor is green, with long halls and a large number of rooms.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VOID_FIRST_FLOOR_1: The hotel is being consumed by something the Bellhop calls "The Void." Something is messing with the objectivity of the hotel and making it malleable. However, this instability is causing it to be a prime target for this entity.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_POOLS_RUMOR_1: There is a locked room labeled "POOLS" on the first floor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_POOLS_RUMOR_2: A sticky note mentioned that the key was taken by a denizen of the hotel, who was also messing with the wallpaper. The author could not bring themself to vandalize the wallpaper to see what they wrote under it.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_POOLS_1: The Pools are a nonsensical array of swimming pools spread across the floor, walls, and ceiling.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_SECOND_FLOOR_RUMOR_1: The Bellhop told me that when I visit the second floor, I should follow the signs or I will get lost.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_SECOND_FLOOR_1: The second floor is red, with a rather orderly and samey layout.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VOID_SECOND_FLOOR_1: About three-quarters into the loop, the second floor gets consumed by the void.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FURNACE_RUMOR_1: There is a furnace on the second floor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FURNACE_1: I located a furnace on the second floor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FURNACE_2: The furnace has a dial that I can turn. It has notches labeled "B", "1", "2", and "3".
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_THIRD_FLOOR_RUMOR_1: The Bellhop told me that the third floor is supposed to be largely unoccupied, and he doesn't believe there are any locked doors up there.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_THIRD_FLOOR_1: The third floor is purple, with an open layout. There are not many rooms here.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_THIRD_FLOOR_2: I found a locked door at room 323.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VOID_THIRD_FLOOR_1: Halfway into the loop, the third floor is consumed by the void.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VAULT_RUMOR_1: I have found a safe of some kind that I can open. It is empty.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VAULT_RUMOR_2: Green mentioned that if I lost something, it would have been put in the lost-and-found safe on the third floor. If I can't find it, I should project my belief that it exists when it's closed.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VAULT_1: After projecting my belief of the Advanced Warp Core onto the empty safe while it was closed, it appeared when I opened it.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_1: After speaking with the Purple Wisp, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_2: After speaking with the Purple Echo, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_3: After telling the Purple Ripple I had done all they asked, they allowed me to scan them.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_1: Lining up the wisp with one of its aspects then projecting my beliefs with the Signalscope caused them to merge.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_2: I merged all three aspects together into one being.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_WISP_RUMOR_1: I found a Purple Wisp hiding in one of the rooms.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_WISP_1: The Purple Wisp speaks in exhaustive prose.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_WISP_2: They mentioned an impassible barrier and a small favor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_ECHO_RUMOR_1: Right outside of my room, there is a barrier blocking my access to part of the building.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_ECHO_1: I sent the hall back in time to before the barrier existed, which gave me access to a room with a Purple Echo.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_ECHO_2: The Purple Echo speaks in exhaustive prose.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_RIPPLE_RUMOR_1: I found a Purple Ripple hiding in room 315.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_RIPPLE_1: The Purple Ripple speaks in exhaustive prose.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_RIPPLE_2: After speaking to them, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_RIPPLE_3: I tried to scan their signal, but they would not permit it unless I did a small favor for them
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_1: After talking to the Blue Wisp, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_2: After talking to the Blue Echo, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_3: After talking to the Blue Ripple, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_1: Lining up the wisp with one of its aspects then projecting my beliefs with the Signalscope caused them to merge.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_2: I merged all three aspects together into one being.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_WISP_RUMOR_1: I discovered a blue wisp in a room on the first floor. They speak with brevity.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_WISP_1: They mentioned splashing and a block of ice in a locked room.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_ECHO_RUMOR_1: I found a sticky note mentioning a temporal disturbance. It is apparently invisible akin to ghost matter. The author wondered what might happen if it was impacted with high kinetic energy.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_ECHO_1: Hitting the disturbance created a bubble. It seems the bubble brings the surrounding space back in time.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_ECHO_2: Within the bubble was a blue echo. They spoke with brevity.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_RIPPLE_RUMOR_1: I found a block of ice in room 323 on the third floor of the Void Hotel.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_RIPPLE_RUMOR_2: I set the furnace to send its heat to the third floor. It was able to melt the ice.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_RIPPLE_1: Within the block of ice was a Blue Ripple. They spoke with brevity.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_1: After speaking with the Green Wisp, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_2: After speaking with the Green Echo, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_3: After speaking with the Green Ripple, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_1: Lining up the wisp with one of its aspects then projecting my beliefs with the Signalscope caused them to merge.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_2: I merged all three aspects together into one being.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_WISP_RUMOR_1: I found a green wisp on the second floor. They speak in poetry.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_WISP_1: They mentioned a music box and signs in a maze, changing with the time.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_ECHO_RUMOR_1: I found a music box. It is aged and out of tune.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_ECHO_1: I played the music box in the past, when it was still in tune, which revealed a secret compartment. Inside of the compartment was a Green Echo. They speak in poetry.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_RIPPLE_RUMOR_1: I found a poem mentioning starting from a misspelled "Exit" sign.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_RIPPLE_RUMOR_2: I found a poem saying to only go left until the flickering light.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_RIPPLE_RUMOR_3: I found a poem saying to try the locked door three times until it opened, then to visit the locked door in the void.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_RIPPLE_1: I found a Green Ripple. They speak in poetry.
